correctness.rationale: Length-one observations give zero and one totals; lengths two determine the two run counts; length-three counts refine them to zero/one singleton-run counts plus endpoint correction. The exact formulas N000=z-2r0+a0 and N111=p-2r1+a1, and mixed triples from boundary terms, also give the converse: the finite run signature determines every composition multiplicity. The enumeration separates endpoint cases with r0-r1 in {-1,0,1} and performs an inclusion-exclusion correction on their single overlap. For each feasible signature, the diagonal generating series for run excesses is geometric, so the eleven-term finite rational sum is exhaustive. Its common-denominator integer-polynomial equality proves the displayed rational generating function for all n, and partial fractions give the period-four quartic. Constant words and n=1 are separate. Independent direct enumeration of all words n=1..12 reproduces the counts (2,3,6,10,20,35,62,101,160,241,354,502). It does not establish the infinite identity; the run bijection and rational algebra do.

value.rationale: The maximal number of codewords distinguishable by a fixed small composition window is a natural exact reconstruction invariant; the shift from quadratic r=2 growth to a quartic, period-four r=3 law precisely identifies the information unlocked by one additional substring length. The all-n generating function is a substantive enumeration, not a sampled code table or trivial substitution.

final_claim: For every binary word length n>=1, the number R_3(n) of distinct noiseless composition multisets from all contiguous factors of lengths at most 3 equals the coefficient of z^n in z(2-5z+6z^2-4z^3+4z^4-z^5+2z^6-3z^7+2z^8)/((1-z)^4(1-z^4)). For n>=2 it is the asserted period-four quartic (3n^4-16n^3+114n^2-272n+c_{n mod 4})/96, c=(480,555,456,555), with R_3(1)=2 and R_3(n)=n^4/32+O(n^3). R_3 is the maximum code cardinality with distinct such observations, not a decoding or error-correction claim.
limitations: Binary linear words and all contiguous factors of lengths at most three, with multiplicities, only.
The result gives exact possible-observation count and existential maximal code size, not individual class sizes, an efficient encoder/decoder, corrupted observations or larger alphabets.
